about: Phase 5, round 2: the coverage set of 12, each a type no earlier test built and none of round 1's. Three per structure; half are shapes settle has no recipe for (cov-code, cov-leaderboard, cov-scatter, cov-kanban, cov-calendar, cov-flashcards). Five run in a project, named by fixture: Next.js, Astro, Vue and Svelte, and a plain HTML site whose FAQ already exists. The rest bring words and contexts round 1 lacks: premium, like an iPhone, a dashboard on a TV, a newsletter, calm, colourful, a printed ticket, a dark subject, a vertical story and a one-off video intro.

requests.request: the part of my app's login where you type the 6 digit code we text you. make it feel premium
A leaderboard for our office step challenge that we can put on the TV as a dashboard. Scores update every few seconds and people should move up and down as they pass each other.
a board in my app for tracking my job applications, where i drag each one from applied to interview to offer
a colourful vertical video for my instagram story showing how my plant app reminds you to water your plants
a share menu that slides up from the bottom when you tap share, like on an iphone, and you can swipe it down to close
For my newsletter, a chart of every day I wrote this year: one little square per day, darker on the days I wrote more.
A calendar page that shows my gym classes for the month, where I can flip to the next month.
for my event ticket app's homepage, a short looping animation of someone's ticket getting scanned at the door
the questions on my faq page just snap open and shut. can you make them open smoothly?
a chart for my blog post about the coffee shops in my town. each shop is a dot: cheaper to the left, better coffee higher up
flashcards for my spanish words: tap a card to flip it and see the english, swipe it away for the next one. keep it calm, studying stresses me out
a 5 second intro for the start of my astronomy videos on youtube, with my channel name, Deep Field
